data.body: Companion meta-process bug filed: f6cc-b174-9e9a-435c — 'hardcoded 1000-issue ACLI ceiling shipped without working-set size verification'. 5f2a covers the production-only code-defect cluster (test gaps / dual-load keys / git identity / repo-root); f6cc covers a different process gap (unverified operational thresholds + missed REPLAN_ESCALATE). Both should inform the same planning-process retrospective.
